text: CHIEF PRE-PROPOSAL RECHECK: exact ca9bcfa7d9992c2d4d1b1ed2b6b82f539dfcaa3e remains BLOCKED and must not be proposed. Qualified package privacy is not an issuer boundary because Scala packages are open to downstream source. In an exact ca9 archive I added independently compiled probe d36eb0b8b1c3fd8742da82ea5486aa4f18380d92eb0685f9787998a30fa9d28f under package storymodel4s.consumerattack. It called ViewEvidenceAdmitter.trusted, retained the caller-appointed fingerprint, and obtained the fixtureReview issuance function; sbt acquireJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.consumerattack.PackageRootIssuerBypassSuite exited 0, 1/1 pass. A second probe 410e89e294c303ec4e1730dfee8eb0eb7519fcdd71b3209c9ac6d13ab4217668 under package storymodel4s.acquire.attack directly retained AdmittedViewEvidence.admit; its targeted test also exited 0, 1/1 pass. Moving the candidate probe to package outputprobe only proves access outside the qualified package name, not outside the library artifact or trusted code. private[storymodel4s] and private[acquire] are caller-selectable namespaces, exactly the package-scoped remedy the prior ruling excluded. FINAL CURRENT-SCOPE REMEDY: do not implement human or fixture issuance in this slice. Remove ViewEvidenceAdmitter and every data-only or qualified-private path to AdmittedViewEvidence; remove/defer evidence-assisted decoding and positive HumanAdjudication/FixtureReview authority construction. The honest v1 admitted path is ValidatedBuild only. Human/fixture wire labels, if retained at all, must remain untrusted and refuse rather than produce AdmittedViewBasis. Add the same two adversarial package names as refusal courts plus a runtime court that arbitrary public data cannot yield human/fixture authority; retain ValidatedBuild as positive control. Do not run another full gate until those probes refuse. If a real trust root is desired, checkpoint first: it needs a bare-private token whose companion can verify an allowlisted fixture or cryptographically verifiable issuer, which is separate ADR/public-vocabulary/dependency authority. Preserve ca9 framing and source/build joins.
